f1.description: Reintroduce F1: drop the webhook event-id record, so a redelivered event is processed again. F2's key still keeps the balance right; the spec catches the missing event row.
expectedFailures: F1 a redelivered event is recorded once and credits the creator once

f2.description: Reintroduce F2: unkey the ledger transaction, so two events for one occurrence credit twice. F7's repeated order gets the same charge back from the provider and records it twice, so it fails too.
expectedFailures: F2 two events for one occurrence credit the creator once
F7 a lost capture response and an order repeated after a restart capture once

f3.description: Reintroduce F3: drop a refund or dispute that arrives before its capture instead of parking it.
expectedFailures: F3 a refund or dispute that arrives before its capture is applied once the capture exists

f4.description: Reintroduce F4: key refunds by the charge id, dropping every partial refund after the first. F5's full-refund-in-parts check needs every partial, so it fails too.
expectedFailures: F4 a second partial refund is applied
F5 partial refunds split without rounding drift and a full refund in parts ends at zero

f5.description: Reintroduce F5: round each refund line independently, drifting by cents.
expectedFailures: F5 partial refunds split without rounding drift and a full refund in parts ends at zero

f6.description: Reintroduce F6: reconcile by count instead of amount per creator.
expectedFailures: F6 reconciliation flags an amount drift per creator

f7.description: Reintroduce F7: a fresh idempotency key per capture attempt, with no key stored per order.
expectedFailures: F7 a lost capture response and an order repeated after a restart capture once

f8.description: Reintroduce F8: a dispute reverses only the creator earnings.
expectedFailures: F8 a dispute reverses the creator earnings, the referral reward and the platform share

f9.description: Reintroduce F9: no payout intent is read, and an unknown outcome is resent blindly.
expectedFailures: F9 an unknown payout outcome is looked up and a repeated payout request pays once
